notes: rust-stdlib-crypto over the reviewed RustCrypto dsa crate (0.7.0, with its hazmat feature for the private key type and pkcs8 for PKIX DER). Embedding is a public field plus Deref; *big.Int fields are bigint::Int. The crate supports the FIPS 186-3 parameter sizes only and truncates a hash longer than Q to its leftmost N/8 bytes (Go reduces it modulo Q and leaves truncation to the caller); Go's panics become false/errors.

GenerateKey.note: Go's reader argument becomes `dsa::generate_key_with_rng`, which takes the reader first; the plain function uses the system source (ADR 0005). Go always honours the reader.

GenerateParameters.note: Go's reader argument becomes `dsa::generate_parameters_with_rng`, which takes the reader first; the plain function uses the system source (ADR 0005). Go always honours the reader.

Sign.note: only the FIPS 186-3 parameter sizes (1024/160, 2048/224, 2048/256, 3072/256) are supported, and a hash longer than Q is truncated to its leftmost N/8 bytes as FIPS 186-3 section 4.6 says; Go's reader argument becomes `dsa::sign_with_rng`, which takes the reader first; the plain function uses the system source (ADR 0005). Go 1.26+ ignores the reader unless GODEBUG=cryptocustomrand=1.

Verify.note: as Sign: other parameter sizes verify as false
